entries.title: Psalms 5:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. With flutes. A Psalm of David.>> Give ear to my words, O LORD, Consider my meditation.

entries.title: Psalms 5:2
segments: Give heed to the voice of my cry, My King and my God, For to You I will pray.

entries.title: Psalms 5:3
segments: My voice You shall hear in the morning, O LORD; In the morning I will direct [it] to You, And I will look up.

entries.title: Psalms 5:4
segments: For You [are] not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness, Nor shall evil dwell with You.

entries.title: Psalms 5:5
segments: The boastful shall not stand in Your sight; You hate all workers of iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 5:6
segments: You shall destroy those who speak falsehood; The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

entries.title: Psalms 5:7
segments: ¶But as for me, I will come into Your house in the multitude of Your mercy; In fear of You I will worship toward Your holy temple.

entries.title: Psalms 5:8
segments: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; Make Your way straight before my face.

entries.title: Psalms 5:9
segments: For [there is] no faithfulness in their mouth; Their inward part [is] destruction; Their throat [is] an open tomb; They flatter with their tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 5:10
segments: Pronounce them guilty, O God! Let them fall by their own counsels; Cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions, For they have rebelled against You.

entries.title: Psalms 5:11
segments: But let all those rejoice who put their trust in You; Let them ever shout for joy, because You defend them; Let those also who love Your name Be joyful in You.

entries.title: Psalms 5:12
segments: For You, O LORD, will bless the righteous; With favor You will surround him as [with] a shield.
